verses.en: Praise ye the LORD. I will praise the LORD with my whole heart, in the assembly of the upright, and in the congregation.
verses.pt: Louvai ao Senhor. De todo o coração darei graças ao Senhor, no concílio dos retos e na congregação.
verses.en_web: Praise Yah! I will give thanks to Yahweh with my whole heart, in the council of the upright, and in the congregation.
verses.en_bbe: Let the Lord be praised. I will give praise to the Lord with all my heart, among the upright, and in the meeting of the people.

verses.en: The works of the LORD are great, sought out of all them that have pleasure therein.
verses.pt: Grandes são as obras do Senhor, e para serem estudadas por todos os que nelas se comprazem.
verses.en_web: Yahweh’s works are great, pondered by all those who delight in them.
verses.en_bbe: The works of the Lord are great, searched out by all those who have delight in them.

verses.en: His work is honourable and glorious: and his righteousness endureth for ever.
verses.pt: Glória e majestade há em sua obra; e a sua justiça permanece para sempre.
verses.en_web: His work is honor and majesty. His righteousness endures forever.
verses.en_bbe: His work is full of honour and glory; and his righteousness is unchanging for ever.

verses.en: He hath made his wonderful works to be remembered: the LORD is gracious and full of compassion.
verses.pt: Ele fez memoráveis as suas maravilhas; compassivo e misericordioso é o Senhor.
verses.en_web: He has caused his wonderful works to be remembered. Yahweh is gracious and merciful.
verses.en_bbe: Certain for ever is the memory of his wonders: the Lord is full of pity and mercy.

verses.en: He hath given meat unto them that fear him: he will ever be mindful of his covenant.
verses.pt: Dá mantimento aos que o temem; lembra-se sempre do seu pacto.
verses.en_web: He has given food to those who fear him. He always remembers his covenant.
verses.en_bbe: He has given food to his worshippers; he will keep his agreement in mind for ever.

verses.en: He hath shewed his people the power of his works, that he may give them the heritage of the heathen.
verses.pt: Mostrou ao seu povo o poder das suas obras, dando-lhe a herança das nações.
verses.en_web: He has shown his people the power of his works, in giving them the heritage of the nations.
verses.en_bbe: He has made clear to his people the power of his works, giving them the heritage of the nations.

verses.en: The works of his hands are verity and judgment; all his commandments are sure.
verses.pt: As obras das suas mãos são verdade e justiça; fiéis são todos os seus preceitos;
verses.en_web: The works of his hands are truth and justice. All his precepts are sure.
verses.en_bbe: The works of his hands are faith and righteousness; all his laws are unchanging.

verses.en: They stand fast for ever and ever, and are done in truth and uprightness.
verses.pt: firmados estão para todo o sempre; são feitos em verdade e retidão.
verses.en_web: They are established forever and ever. They are done in truth and uprightness.
verses.en_bbe: They are fixed for ever and ever, they are done in faith and righteousness.

verses.en: He sent redemption unto his people: he hath commanded his covenant for ever: holy and reverend is his name.
verses.pt: Enviou ao seu povo a redenção; ordenou para sempre o seu pacto; santo e tremendo é o seu nome.
verses.en_web: He has sent redemption to his people. He has ordained his covenant forever. His name is holy and awesome!
verses.en_bbe: He has sent salvation to his people; he has given his word for ever: holy is his name and greatly to be feared.

verses.en: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom: a good understanding have all they that do his commandments: his praise endureth for ever.
verses.pt: O temor do Senhor é o princípio da sabedoria; têm bom entendimento todos os que cumprem os seus preceitos; o seu louvor subsiste para sempre.
verses.en_web: The fear of Yahweh is the beginning of wisdom. All those who do his work have a good understanding. His praise endures forever!
verses.en_bbe: The fear of the Lord is the best part of wisdom: all those who keep his laws are wise: his praise is eternal.
